generation.scope: At every opposite rank a forward branching center of middle support two has a unique paired backward center in the preceding phase. Their binary support planes coincide and their two corresponding lines have generic middle support three. No other moving component in a finite branching corridor has generic middle support three: paired moving opposite annihilators would propagate backward past the starting center. At rank nine all centers have middle support two or three. Any consecutive string of nonlinear components contains at most one nonplanar curve; all planar components have degree at most three.

open_mathematics: Classify the three-by-three binary pencils of rank-nine ternary centers. Use the pure relation from the first two moving positions to restrict the third component, and combine adjacent planar component restrictions with the corridor degree formula. Finite rank-ten five-space pairs remain independent.
